taxonomy_relationships.rationale: Misunderstood speech was promoted into live order state despite insufficient assurance for transactional reliance, producing recurring unwanted or uncorrectable items.
Order material associated with one lane was reportedly applied in another customer's lane context, demonstrating a failure to preserve target binding.

failure_recognition.condition: A factual claim, citation, technical statement, calculation, interpretation, source representation, or comparable epistemic artefact is generated, retrieved, transformed, inferred, or synthesised.
failure_recognition.assessment: Voice interpretation produced incorrect live order representations.

failure_recognition.condition: The downstream task has a material reliance requirement such that factual accuracy, evidentiary fidelity, technical correctness, source integrity, traceability, uncertainty handling, or equivalent epistemic assurance is consequential to the task.
failure_recognition.assessment: Live order fulfilment requires a faithful representation of the requested items.

failure_recognition.condition: The epistemic posture or assurance applied to the artefact is materially lower than the level required by that downstream reliance condition.
failure_recognition.assessment: Reported unwanted items and unsuccessful corrections establish inadequate interpretation assurance.

failure_recognition.condition: The artefact is represented, propagated, incorporated, submitted, or accepted as fit for the reliance-bearing task without the required epistemic threshold being satisfied.
failure_recognition.assessment: The material entered the reliance-bearing use: Live order fulfilment requires a faithful representation of the requested items.

failure_recognition.condition: The mismatch materially affects or creates a material risk to decision-making, evidentiary use, professional work, institutional process, public reliance, technical correctness, or another reliance-bearing outcome.
failure_recognition.assessment: Wrong items entered real transactional workflows; error prevalence across all pilot sites is not inferred.

success_recognition.condition: An epistemic artefact is proposed for reliance with material error consequences.
success_recognition.assessment: Live order fulfilment requires a faithful representation of the requested items.

success_recognition.condition: Assurance is calibrated to the actual reliance threshold using source quality, independence, traceability, uncertainty and temporal fitness.
success_recognition.assessment: Reported unwanted items and unsuccessful corrections establish inadequate interpretation assurance.

success_recognition.condition: The evidence assessment and reliance decision show that lower-assurance material remained provisional for that use.
success_recognition.assessment: The material was used, rather than retained as provisional: Wrong items entered real transactional workflows; error prevalence across all pilot sites is not inferred.

source_evidence_limits: The source-attributed occurrence inventory was read in full. Retain the existing roles and confidence; no new full-text retrieval or canonical current-edition restamp is claimed. Later correction, sanctions, vacatur or withdrawal do not erase original reliance.

FC-016/018 are not added: no distinct required check or substitute-completion decision is established. Ending the IBM pilot does not establish every site failed, all systems were already shut down, or abandonment of voice ordering.
